verdict.rationale: Zamzar is a cloud file-conversion service, and a SaaS product of this kind could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents format conversions, compression and file handling, with no AI analysis, insights or suggestions. 'MP3 to Text' is a format conversion, not insight generation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
